title: Takeaway packaging pack (not cart)
summary: Takeaway/Delivery packaging is deducted automatically once per bill — not added as POS cart lines. Configure under Inventory → Takeaway pack (bag, napkin, etc.). Per-dish boxes still go on the dish recipe.
highlights: Industry rule: pack is order-level, not a menu line (unless bag fee)
Inventory → Takeaway pack: enable + pick stock items + qty per order
Applies on Takeaway and optional Delivery
Food recipes still deduct food; pack adds bag/napkin once per bill
